title: Grasslands, Open Country & Dry Landforms Archetype Evaluation

decision.reason: All eight ENV-08 environments are cleanly expressible through Open Country and, where strong relief materially changes traversal, Highland. Grassland, savanna, steppe, scrub, rocky-desert substrate and salt-flat substrate are preset parameters and ecological/climatic distinctions rather than new reusable topologies.

evaluations.reason: Long sightlines, exposure, distance and sparse fixed shelter are already baseline Open Country behavior.
Scattered trees and seasonal vegetation are preset parameters; they do not create Forest topology.
Dry open grass/shrub terrain remains structurally Open Country.
Dense low scrub alters concealment and footing but not enough to justify a universal new topology.
Rolling elevation and exposed open terrain combine existing reusable behaviors.
Steep relief, route restriction and exposed dry ground are already covered by Highland plus Open Country.
Arid rock fields, mesas and broken terrain are substrate/relief parameterization; heat and drought remain later overlays.
The defining salt/crust substrate does not change the broad open-terrain topology.
